info.name: Order Placement & Delivery API - Real-Time Features Test Suite
info.description: Interactive Postman collection for manual verification of Socket.IO real-time features (price updates, live stock display, cart synchronization, availability changes, and moderation disconnects).

item.name: 0. Setup & Auth (Run Once)
item.description: Creates admin, customer, vendor, and product prerequisites for real-time testing.

item.name: 0.4 Send & Verify Vendor A Phone OTP

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ phone: '+12025550' + pm.environment.get('runId'), otp: pm.environment.get('staticOtp') || '123456' }) }
pm.test('Vendor A phone verified', function () { pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200); });

item.name: 0.5 Send & Verify Vendor A Email OTP

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: 'vendora_' + pm.environment.get('runId') + '@marketplace.com', otp: pm.environment.get('staticOtp') || '123456' }) }
pm.test('Vendor A email verified', function () { pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200); });
pm.test('Vendor A approved by Admin (200)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });

Scenario 4: Product Availability & Moderation
item.description: Tests availability broadcasts on admin disable/enable, vendor toggle, and vendor soft-delete.

exec: pm.test('Item in cart (200 or 201)', function () { pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Product disabled by Admin (200)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
pm.test('Availability toggled to false (200)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
pm.test('Availability restored to true (200)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
